$comment: Mutation testing (ADR-016, FR-030..FR-033). Run through scripts/mutation-diff.mjs: on a change it mutates only the src/ lines the change introduced (break at 100%); with --all it mutates everything, informatively. The vitest runner carries patches/@stryker-mutator+vitest-runner+10.0.0.patch until stryker-js#6210 is released.
$commentMutator: StringLiteral is excluded: free-text strings (Problem Details `detail`, log messages) are prose, not behaviour, and every typed literal (slugs, reasons, statuses) already turns into a compile error under the TypeScript checker when mutated. Everything else mutates.
$commentVitest: vitest.mutation.config.ts is the behavioural suite: the tests that measure latency and snapshot size are excluded (they run per mutant for seconds and kill nothing the rest does not).
$commentIgnoreStatic: ignoreStatic (ADR-016, amended 2026-09-21): a mutant in code that runs outside any test (module load, beforeAll: the bootstrap, the seed, the readers of the configuration) is static; the vitest runner cannot activate it reliably and reports false survivors, and each one runs the whole suite. A static mutant that a test also covers keeps running against those tests (hybrid); one covered by no test is Ignored with its own reason, which mutation-diff.mjs does not count as an undeclared exception. CI is the judge; the local loop is the fast suite.
$commentIncremental: Incremental mode keeps the verdict of every mutant in reports/mutation/stryker-incremental.json (ignored by git; CI caches it per branch) and re-tests only the mutants whose code or covering tests changed: the second push of a PR pays seconds, not minutes. Locally the file is kept too; --all writes its own (stryker-incremental-all.json) so the informative sweep never feeds the gate, and --files re-tests one file with --force. timeoutMS: a mutant that hangs a test is dead either way; 2 s is enough to know.
